purpose: Illustrative hospital imagery; not photographs of a customer hospital.

images.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: wide editorial website photograph, 16:9 landscape.
Primary request: A cinematic photograph of an immaculate contemporary private hospital reception in Pakistan, believable and functional, with a pearl stone reception desk, warm indirect light, large natural windows and understated midnight navy trim. One professional South Asian receptionist is seen at a distance behind the desk.
Style/medium: photorealistic editorial architectural photography, restrained premium hospitality adapted to real private healthcare.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 16:9, immersive spacious reception with desk and distant receptionist, natural perspective.
Lighting/mood: warm natural daylight, quiet and calm operational environment.
Color palette/materials: midnight navy accents, pearl-white stone and clinical materials, very subtle champagne metal.
Constraints: hospital environment must be recognizable, no patients in distress, no text, logos, watermarks, signage or readable screens.
Avoid: science fiction, futuristic spaceships, glowing UI, luxury travel, posed doctors. Generate exactly one image.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: wide editorial final CTA website photograph, 16:9 landscape.
Primary request: A South Asian hospital administrator in understated midnight navy professional attire working at a Windows desktop reception workstation in a believable contemporary private hospital in Pakistan. Photograph the administrator from behind and three-quarter, hands near keyboard, face not dominant.
Scene/backdrop: pearl-white clinical reception with pearl stone counter, understated navy trim and very subtle champagne metal, cohesive restrained premium hospitality adapted to real private healthcare.
Style/medium: photorealistic editorial photography, human and grounded.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 16:9, administrator and desktop on right, uncluttered darker negative space to left for an HTML final CTA.
Lighting/mood: calm warm natural daylight through large windows, gentle indirect light.
Constraints: desktop screen is blurred and unreadable, ordinary credible Windows workstation hardware, no text, logos, watermarks, charts or invented software UI.
Avoid: science fiction, futuristic spaceships, glowing UI, luxury travel, stock doctor posing. Generate exactly one image.
